description: Admin Dashboard - Backend API endpoints for admin operations (user management, usage analytics, credit pricing, admin provider key management) plus a React frontend admin panel accessible to admin users. Includes admin role enforcement and admin-specific UI pages.
steps: Create src/api/middleware/admin.py - get_admin_user dependency that checks user.is_admin flag, returns 403 if not admin.

Create src/api/routers/admin.py - admin endpoints: GET /api/v1/admin/users (list all users with usage stats), GET /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id} (user detail), PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id} (update is_admin, credits), GET /api/v1/admin/usage (global usage analytics), GET /api/v1/admin/provider-keys (list admin provider keys), POST /api/v1/admin/provider-keys (add admin provider key), DELETE /api/v1/admin/provider-keys/{id}, PATCH /api/v1/admin/settings (update credit pricing).
Create src/api/models/admin_settings.py - model for configurable settings like credit_cost_per_1k_chars, stored in DB so admin can change without restart.
Register admin router in src/api/main.py with prefix /api/v1/admin.
Create frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx - admin dashboard with tabs: Users, Usage Analytics, Provider Keys, Settings. Uses Tailwind for styling consistent with existing pages.
Create frontend/src/components/admin/UserTable.tsx - table showing all users with email, credits, usage count, admin status toggle.
Create frontend/src/components/admin/UsageChart.tsx - simple chart/stats display showing global translation usage over time.
Create frontend/src/components/admin/ProviderKeyManager.tsx - UI to add/remove admin provider keys for each provider.
Create frontend/src/components/admin/SettingsPanel.tsx - form to adjust credit pricing and system settings.
Update frontend/src/App.tsx to add /admin route pointing to AdminPage.
Update frontend/src/components/Header.tsx to show Admin link when user has admin role.
acceptance_criteria: Admin endpoints return 403 for non-admin users
Admin can list all users and see their usage statistics
Admin can manage provider keys (add/remove) that are used for credit-based translations
Frontend admin page is accessible at /admin with proper navigation
Admin UI has tabs for Users, Usage, Provider Keys, and Settings
Non-admin users cannot see the Admin link in header
verification: Run pytest tests/ -v to confirm existing tests still pass
Run python -c 'from src.api.routers.admin import router; print(len(router.routes))' to verify admin router loads
cd frontend && npm run build to verify frontend compiles with new admin pages
findings: Backend verified: admin router loads with 9 routes, all 6 OpenAPI paths registered correctly at /api/v1/admin/*. Frontend verified: TypeScript compilation (tsc -b) and Vite production build pass cleanly. Tests: 13 pass, 2 pre-existing failures (no PostgreSQL/Redis available in sandbox). Used python3.12 for backend verification. Used bun (via mise) for frontend build since npm/node not directly in PATH. The bun.lock file was created during install but not committed as it may differ in CI environments.
